title: Dusan brothers and other Streeman trumpeters
summary: Trumpeters Irving and Edward Dusan played with Streeman; Louis Prima reportedly spent time with the band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Yeah. They're vocalists, I guess. Now, Irving Dusan who was presently president of Columbia Homestead, gave up playing trumpet, he's president of Homestead. He has a brother who is an attorney, Edward Dusan. Now he played fine trumpet also. He was with Al Stringer band, had the pleasure of working with him four or five years with the Al Stringer band. He's doing very little playing now. I doubt if he's playing at all, because he's a very busy attorney nowadays. All those fellas, I understand at one time, I don't know how true it is, but I understand Louis Primer even spent two years with Al Stringer. I don't know if that's true or not. I was told that.
It could be before you joined.
